title: 2026-11-25_Umbreon_Rootkit_Investigation_524
description: Security monitoring has detected unusual activity on the victim host, suggesting the presence of a rootkit. Your task is to investigate the compromised system, identify the rootkit's behavior, and determine how it maintains persistence and communicates with the attacker.

levels.title: Suspicious C2 Beaconing Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity that periodically sends beacon to the attacker.
levels.solution:
1. List all running and inactive services using the command:
   ```bash
   systemctl list-units --type=service --all
   ```
2. Look for unfamiliar service names or misspellings of legitimate services. Pay attention to services with unusual descriptions or startup behavior.
3. Identify the service named `espeon.service`, which appears to be related to the suspicious activity.

The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service: `espeon.service`

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Use `systemctl list-units --type=service --all` to list all services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for services with unusual names or descriptions.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious service is related to the beaconing activity.

levels.title: Communication with the Attacker Host Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Inspect the beaconing service definition using the command:
   ```bash
   systemctl cat espeon.service
   ```
2. Pay particular attention to the `ExecStart` line, which specifies the path to the script launched by the beacon service.
3. Open the script located at `/home/cyrano/.kit_beacon.sh` and look for the port number used to establish communication with the attacker.
4. The port number used for communication is `4444`.

The hidden flag is the port number used for communication: `4444`

levels.title: Persistence Discovery for Beacon Service
levels.content: Investigators suspect that a mechanism keeps the beaconing service running across reboots and process termination. Determine which system component is responsible for this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Check the status of the beaconing service using the command:
   ```bash
   systemctl status espeon.service
   ```
2. Look for any related timers or cron jobs that might be responsible for restarting the service.
3. Use the command to list all timers:
   ```bash
   systemctl list-timers --all
   ```
4. The path to the cron job is `/etc/cron.d/dbus-cleanup`.

The hidden flag is the path to the cron job: `/etc/cron.d/dbus-cleanup`
